mean_household_size.note: Used only if the researched mean becomes null.

household_size_distribution.note: Synthetic size weights; when unsourced, reconcile rounding to the researched mean.

age_structure_five_year.note: Synthetic five-year cohorts; deliberately not a reconstructed medieval pyramid.

sex_ratio.note: Equal male/female counts, rounded to whole persons.

ratio_unit.note: Reference sex_ratio unit: males per 100 females.

adult_age.note: Fixture work eligibility and spouse-slot minimum age.

cross_household_kin.note: Disjoint pairs of household heads are siblings; no inferred genealogy beyond those links.

grid_width.note: Arbitrary unit grid; unique residence, work and meeting parcels.

formed_at.note: Initial household snapshot on the fixture clock.

mechanics.note: Algorithmic identities, pair cardinality and JSON indentation, not demographic parameters.
